users: same24 fully enumerated orders in each seed; not72 independent users
AIF: expected terminal normalized-regret reduction +0.1*EIG/log(24); operational active-inference mixture, not a full generative AIF agent
random: with replacement; all arms share initial prior/menu/answers and maximum8questions
deployment: exact posterior expected reward action; no LLM reader
evaluation: transfer to other three excluded-option menus
intervals: none; finite enumerated diagnostic, not a population sample
